# Kanooni Astra

> Kanooni Astra is a law firm based in Ghattekulo Marg, Kathmandu, Nepal, founded on December 5, 2022 by Advocate Praveen Bhattarai, Advocate Rochak Dhungel, and Advocate Sita Bashyal. The firm advises individuals, companies, and NGOs/INGOs on Nepali law across corporate, investment, intellectual property, family, property, criminal, and dispute matters, and represents clients before Nepal's district courts, high courts, and the Supreme Court.
